</span></h1>
</div></div></div></div><div id="x-section-2" class="x-section" ><div id="" class="x-container max width" ><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-1" ><div id="" class="x-text" ><h2>Deals on Kiteboarding Lesson and Hotel Packages</h2>
<p>This is the best Accommodation and Kitesurfing lessons deal you will find on Kitebeach Cabarete!!</p>
<p>Make the most of your Kiteboarding vacation holidays.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div id="x-section-3" class="x-section bg-image" data-x-element="section" data-x-params="{&quot;type&quot;:&quot;image&quot;,&quot;parallax&quot;:false}"><div id="" class="x-container max width" ><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-2" ><div id="" class="x-text" ><h2>Standard Room for <br />
2 person at KitebeachHotels <br />
1 person private VIP lesson.<br />
<span> $989</span></h2>
<h3>6 Day KiteBeach Accommodation for 2 Person with 3 Days Lessons and Supervisions for one person.</h3>
<ul>
<li>Includes 6 nights 2 person accommodation in Kitebeach Hotels standard room with, twin beds, cable TV, and AC. (day&#8217;s more or less $50+ or $50-)</li>
<li>Free WiFi</li>
<li>Access to our online teaching movie library.</li>
<li>4 days private VIP Lesson and Supervisions. Al VIP lesson are done by Stefan Ruether. (1 day more or less $140+ or $140-)<br />
(inc. Equipment)</li>
</ul>
<p>We can customize this package to your needs if you need one Day more or less, different Kiteboarding service or whatever, just let us know.</p>
</div></div><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-2" ><img decoding="async"  class="x-img x-img-none"  src="http://www.kitexcite.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/11/Beginner-course-Level-1-and-21.jpg" ></div></div></div><div id="x-section-4" class="x-section" ><div id="" class="x-container max width" ><div  class="x-column x-sm x-1-1" ><div id="" class="x-text" ><p>*Although Packages offer a better daily rate please be aware that if a lesson or course is cancelled or not completed due to weather, or other circumstances there is no refund on Packages.</p>
